placements.overview:
Infant Jesus College of Engineering, is located in Tirunelveli, Tamil Nadu. Established in 2001, it is a private institute approved by AICTE. Infant Jesus College of Engineering provides 19 UG and PG courses in 8 specialisations, namely Aeronautical Engineering, Agriculture & Farm Engineering, Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning, Civil Engineering and Computer Science Engineering. Theses programmes are offered in Full Time mode. B.E. / B.Tech, M.E./M.Tech and MBA/PGDM are some of the courses offered at Infant Jesus College of Engineering. Some of the streams in which these courses are offered include Engineering and Business & Management Studies. The total fee at Infant Jesus College of Engineering ranges between INR 35,000 to 2,00,000. Infant Jesus College of Engineering has a student intake of 330 for all the courses. Infant Jesus College of Engineering offers all the infrastructural facilities to students.

Infant Jesus College of Engineering offers a wide range of programmes to students at the UG and PG levels. The college is mainly concerned with streams such as Engineering and Business & Management Studies. At the UG level, the college offers courses such as B.E. / B.Tech. At the PG level, the college offers courses such as M.E./M.Tech and MBA/PGDM. Infant Jesus College of Engineering courses are offered to students in Full Time mode. Further, the fees structure for Infant Jesus College of Engineering courses stands around INR 35,000 to 2,00,000.

reviews_list.review_title: The review of Infant Jesus College of Engineering.

review_content.Placements: The MBA graduates from our college got placed with a salary package of 2 LPA recently, and the college also put its efforts to train students for placements. They placed a lot of students in well-reputed companies earlier. They not only offer placement opportunities but also train the students to utilise such opportunities.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college has a robust infrastructure. Each department has its own building. All the departments have their own labs, and the classrooms available here are very spacious. All the labs are well-equipped, and we also have well-trained lab assistants. The college emphasises on lab sessions. As far as the sports are concerned, the college excels in the field of weight lifting as we have the gold medal winner in Commonwealth Games as its coach.

Aptitude test will be conducted on a regular basis.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college is located in beautiful Valanadu hills. The labs are mind-blowing and are equipped with all the latest equipment that gives the practical knowledge to the students. The hostel facilities are good, and food sounds perfect. The medical facility like cab will be available for the hostelers to travel up to the hospital, in case of an emergency.

individual_reviews.title: ABR is the best college to have better future.

content.Placements: The minimum package offered in our course is 4 LPA. ABR College of Engineering is one of the best colleges in Andhra Pradesh which gives good placement opportunities and career options. Most students got internships in various companies, including Infosys, TCS, CTS, Accenture, Wipro, Deloitte, and many others.

individual_reviews.title: Life turning point - Best place.

content.Placements: My seniors are placed in the company Renew. The highest package is 6 LPA in Delhi, Maharashtra, and Bangalore every year from the branch of electrical and electronics engineering. Around 20 members are placed from my college. The highest package in 2022 was 10 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: In the college, library has more than 1000 books, and books are for competitive exams. Classrooms are very good and very comfortable. Labs have more equipments to do experiments. Every year, sports are conducted in my college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Life turning point (UCEKU).

content.Placements: Our seniors got placed in different companies like Renew Power, solar energy, etc., with a package of 6 LPA and 5.5 LPA. Our seniors cracked GATE with our library books and also with our faculty coordination, and in the mining engineering branch, the highest package is 16 LPA, and also a larger number of students are placed in the Singareni coal mine.
content.Infrastructure: Full equipment is available in the lab with high intellectual faculty and classrooms with Wi-Fi connection, and a hostel with good surroundings and with good quality food. Our library contains around 1000 books, and our college campus is around 300 acres, with medical facilities.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Absolute world for students.

content.Placements: About 70% of EEE students are placed in companies like Renew Power, and some startup companies. The highest package is 6 LPA, and the lowest package is 4 LPA. For mining engineering students the package is about 16 LPA and for EEE 3rd year students, there are internship opportunities in DRDO.
content.Infrastructure: There is a full of realistic and most green atmosphere around our college and hostel with full of security cameras. It also has security guards and around 1,000 books are there in the library for technical and competitive books for students to grasp knowledge for flexible hours of time.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: University College of Engineering at Kakatiya University, Bhadradri Kothagudem.

content.Placements: 90% of the students placed in our college, UCEKU. The highest package in my college was 24 LPA, and the lowest package was 1 LPA. The Kothagudem Thermal Power Station had placements for me, and mining engineering was the top branch in our college.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel was good, but the Wi-Fi was not available in our hostel. The classrooms were good, and the library was big in our college. The classroom furniture was not good, but the blackboards were excellent. The faculty members were also excellent.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: A environment to boost th passion .

content.Placements: The college has a good reputation, but we were disappointed with the placements. No students were placed in the CS course, and the average package for students who were placed in the mining course was only 10-13 LPA. In addition, no students received any internship opportunities from any company.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is old and in poor condition. The hostel is located 8 to 10 kilometers away from the city, and Wi-Fi was very slow and not available to hostel residents. The canteen is available, but there are no water facilities, and the environment is old.

individual_reviews.title: Very good infrastructure and good placement are available in this college.

content.Placements: About 70% of students have got placements after taking this course. Highest package is 8 LPA, and lowest package is 4 LPA. Medical facilities are very good in both the hostel and the college.

individual_reviews.title: Examfree curriculum which makes you tensefree.

content.Placements: Here is about my college. It's completely different from other colleges' curriculum and they follow that in well and good manner. review_content.Placements: This is the first batch of AI/ML here. Around 120 students have been placed in this batch. Top recruiting companies include TCS, Amazon, and Microsoft. reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. in Data Analytics - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Take admission if we have no other choice.

review_content.Placements: There are 50 students in my B.Sc data analytics branch, only 10 students are placed for the internships. The effort of placement is very disappointing. We even cannot take the job of core subject because college only call sales jobs and the call center jobs.
review_content.Infrastructure: Our college campus is very small, even we do not have college life here. Campus is very small and does not have a canteen facility. If we are a sports person and want a field to play then do not take admission here. Infrastructure is very low, and college does not have any sports also.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Campus is small but the infrastructure is top notch.

review_content.Placements: In my college, the course of B.Tech. is taken in 2024, so no one batch is passed out yet. only my batch will be the first that passes out firstly in 2028. That's why I am not giving any stars. I'll update my review when I'll get information about the package and programming and other things that never happened.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure and facilities are good, and the building is new; that's why everything is good. On the other hand, the lab and library are fully air-conditioned, and all books are available. Sports ground isn't available, but the tournament is held in a stadium between other campuses of DSEU.

reviews_list.batch_info: BBA in Banking, Financial Service and Insurance - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Strong Industry Focus and Vibrant Campus Life at Bhai Parmanand Institute of Business Studies.

review_content.Placements: For the students belonging to my batch of Bhai Parmanand Institute of Business Studies, 75% of the students got placed. The highest package offered was INR 7 LPA, while the lowest was INR 3 LPA, and the average was INR 4 LPA. Some of the leading recruiters were HDFC, ICICI, and TCS. All in all, approximately 80% of the student population was placed in internships, some of which are with Bajaj Capital and HDFC, with most of the positions taken being finance, marketing, and analysis.
review_content.Infrastructure: The facilities that I will be making use of for my course at Bhai Parmanand Institute of Business Studies include a modern classroom, a computer laboratory equipped with the latest technology, an internet connection, and a library. At the moment, hostel facilities are not available.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. in Data Analytics - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: College review of Bhai Parmanand DSEU Shakarpur Campus - II.

review_content.Placements: Our college does not provide us with internships; we have to find them ourselves. DSEU has collaborated with many companies, but they didn't come to hire students for internships or placements. About 8 to 10 students get placed every year out of 120 students.
review_content.Infrastructure: At my college, there is less infrastructure. There is no computer lab, no Wi-Fi connection, no AC and limited classrooms. There are no hostels or good canteens in my college, and there are limited food options. There are also no medical, sports, or recreation facilities.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. in Data Analytics - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: The reality of data analytics in DSEU.

review_content.Placements: Since last semester, students have become eligible for campus placements. Average of about 5-7 companies visited & 50 offers made. The highest package is 5 LPA, and the average package is 3 LPA. Approximately 35–40% of students get placed. A company named 99 Acres offers a post of data analyst for an internship. The stipend offered by the company is 15,000 per month. At the internship, there are projects focused on Excel and CRM. But I suggest you get an internship on your own.
review_content.Infrastructure: The average campus area of the college is very small. The class and labs are well maintained by the staff. There are no hostels or PGs provided by the university. The bad aspects are that the campus is small and there is no support if you have an interest in sports or ECAs. In DSEU, you will get a proper environment for studying. There is a shortage of canteen availability on campus.

reviews.review_heading: This is the first batch for CSE students, and the infrastructure is good.
reviews.review_text: Everything is new and in good condition. Faculty members are strict about maintaining a clean and good infrastructure. Any college-related issues are resolved within 2 to 3 working days; you just need to write a letter to the head. After all, the college is good.

reviews.review_heading: Take admission if we have no other choice.
reviews.review_text: Our college campus is very small, even we do not have college life here. Campus is very small and does not have a canteen facility. If we are a sports person and want a field to play then do not take admission here. Infrastructure is very low, and college does not have any sports also.

reviews.review_heading: Campus is small but the infrastructure is top notch.
reviews.review_text:
Infrastructure and facilities are good, and the building is new; that's why everything is good.
On the other hand, the lab and library are fully air-conditioned, and all books are available.
Sports ground isn't available, but the tournament is held in a stadium between other campuses of DSEU.

reviews.review_heading: Strong Industry Focus and Vibrant Campus Life at Bhai Parmanand Institute of Business Studies.
reviews.review_text: The facilities that I will be making use of for my course at Bhai Parmanand Institute of Business Studies include a modern classroom, a computer laboratory equipped with the latest technology, an internet connection, and a library. At the moment, hostel facilities are not available.

reviews.review_heading: College review of Bhai Parmanand DSEU Shakarpur Campus - II.
reviews.review_text: At my college, there is less infrastructure. There is no computer lab, no Wi-Fi connection, no AC and limited classrooms. There are no hostels or good canteens in my college, and there are limited food options. There are also no medical, sports, or recreation facilities.

reviews.review_heading: The reality of data analytics in DSEU.
reviews.review_text: The average campus area of the college is very small. The class and labs are well maintained by the staff. There are no hostels or PGs provided by the university. The bad aspects are that the campus is small and there is no support if you have an interest in sports or ECAs. In DSEU, you will get a proper environment for studying. There is a shortage of canteen availability on campus.

reviews.review_heading: Low infrastructure, low college culture, good faculty and courses, and average placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure was average the college building was not that good the classrooms doesn't have AC's. However, the libraries were good with AC and Wi-Fi and the classrooms also had Wi-Fi for students and projectors. The hostel was not available in our college.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Bhai Parmanand DSEU Shakarpur Campus - II.
reviews.review_text: In our college, no wi-fi facilities are available. There is library but not all books are available. The canteen is also closed now. Labs are there but not accessible to all. If I talk about sports, then I say no sports are there; you have to bring your own equipment to play, like badminton, and the ground is also too small.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the college is good, and the faculty is also very good.
reviews.review_text: Currently, our college doesn't provide any hostel or PG accommodation, but hostels are planned for the future. The infrastructure facilities are very good, with filtered drinking water, a library with a huge amount of books of different types, Wi-Fi, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Comprehensive insights : my college experience.
reviews.review_text: The ShakurPur campus feels rather small and reminisces of a school setting; however, it's worth nothing that the main campus in Dwarka hosts most of the festivals. Despite its size, the library impressed with its collection of books, albeit limited due to space constraints.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely dissatisfied because of fest, infrastructure, and facilities.
reviews.review_text:
At my college, there is less infrastructure. There is no computer lab, no Wi-Fi connection, no AC, no projectors and limited classrooms.
There are no hostels or good canteens in my college, and there are limited food options. There are also no medical, sports, or recreation facilities.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college with excellent teachers.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides good infrastructure. Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus. Computer labs are good. A library is available. Air-conditioners are not available in classrooms. It is very difficult to go to college in the summer.

reviews.review_heading: Everything is good in our college.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are not provided in our college, and its area is small. Its infrastructure is average. Washrooms are clean but have a shortage of water. Air-conditioners are not provided in all the classrooms.

reviews.review_heading: College where you need to do hard work.
reviews.review_text: Yes Wi-Fi is on for all the students, faculty regarding canteen, it is also good and most importantly in the whole campus there is cleanliness which is quite nice. For now there is no hostel facilities available in this campus of DSEU, but we can hope in near fuit is available.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, a good college with lack of space.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms are clean and tidy, with all the facilities. The only thing missing from our college is air conditioners. The college also has a new building, which is currently under construction. Once that is completed, the AC problem will be solved. Hostels are not available.

content.Placements: 100% of the students of IPM get a social internship and a corporate internship in reputed companies. Companies such as The Leela, Microsoft, and Shopper Stop have been the prominent recruiters. The highest stipend stood at Rs. 50,000, while the average stood at Rs. 28,000. (Information according to the official placement reports, IPM Batch 2021-26. )
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus, and we have a state-of-the-art library with e-library access as well. There's an infirmary on our campus where 24-hour nursing staff is available, and a doctor is available every weekday. We also have our own ambulance and wheelchair. The mess facilities are amazing as well because they are student-run, and our friends and our batch mates are a part of it. So, we are always heard, and it makes an impact.

individual_reviews.course: Integrated Program in Management (IPM) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Reality of IIM - the institute of national Importance.

content.Placements: Almost all the students were unofficially placed, but almost half of the batch before the placement season were not able to secure placements in good organizations. The highest package this year was 24 lakes I believe, the average was 16 and the lowest was not disclosed. Top recruiting companies are ICICI, Deloitte, HDFC, and Barkley. Internships in our institute are a credit-based subject so all were placed. Top roles are offered in finance and marketing.
content.Infrastructure: We have 2 campuses for IIM Jammu, the canal road where the IPM batch is residing right now, has really bad infrastructure and bad hostel rooms. Classrooms have damaged projectors. The Wi-Fi is working and the library is too small to even have 20 people. Apart from that the Jagti campus, where the MBA is residing has a state of the art campus and everything is good there as it is new.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: It's a massive and wonderful experience there.

content.Placements: Over 91% of students are placed in our department. Many are placed in large recruitment agencies. The maximum salary offered will be 25 LPA, and the minimum salary will be 10 LPA. The average salary was around 17 LPA. Many big companies like TCS, Google, Infosys, HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, and Cognizant come to recruit students. Nearly 84% of students received internships in various industries. The top roles offered in my course are marketing manager, financial analyst, and human resources manager, etc.
content.Infrastructure: My college infrastructure is very wonderful. The course has state-of-the-art infrastructure such as classrooms with Wi-Fi, state-of-the-art laboratories, a well-equipped library, and access to online databases. The rooms have all the necessary facilities. Food is designed to keep you healthy. The college has adequate medical facilities and facilities for sports.

individual_reviews.course: Integrated Program in Management (IPM) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: IIM IN PARADISE: Indian Institute of Management, Jammu.

content.Placements: There is surety of 100% placement for the MBA as well as for the SIP during various courses. The placements are also in highly branded and value companies. However, the IPM programme which offers social and corporate internships provides an opportunity equal to the MBA course.
content.Infrastructure: The new Jagti campus is huge and highly oriented for students comfort and safety. Even though it is still in construction, basic facilities are well provided. Whereas, the CRC campus is cozy yet, a bit behind in infrastructure. Canal Road campus is totally IPM-oriented.

individual_reviews.course: Integrated Program in Management (IPM) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: A good college to experience real college life.

content.Placements: 100 percent of placements were done in IIM Jammu, and the highest package for the last batch was INR 64 lacs per annum, and the average package was INR 16.5 lacs per annum. The top recruiting companies were Aditya Birla Group, cognizant, ICICI Bank, Capgemini, Accenture, etc.
content.Infrastructure: In IIM Jammu, we have good infrastructure facilities that are well sufficient on both the permanent campus and the current campus. We have a library, basketball court, volleyball court, badminton court, and many indoor sports facilities. The food is just like the average hostel, and hostels are fine.

paragraphs: IIM Jammu admission 2025to itsflagship MBA/ PGPcourse is done through CAT. Indian Institute of Management (IIM), Jammu offers five courses in Management from the postgraduate level to the Doctoral level including two integrated courses. Apart from MBA-PGP, IIM Jammu also accepts CAT scores for admission to its Executive MBA and PhD courses. For IIM Jammu IPM admissions, students must appear for JIPMAT conducted by NTA.IIM Jammualso offers a dual degree programme in collaboration with IIT Jammu combining BTech and MBA. Go through the article to know about courses, selection criteria, eligibility and other admission related information for the institute.
At IIM Jammu, students are offered courses through full-time, residential, online and blended modes. Check the following table to learn more about IIM Jammu admission highlights:

On the other hand, selection is based on candidate's performance on CAT or other relevant examinations accepted for admission to the courses, followed by a personal interview round. IIM Jammu courses admissionis based on entrance exam scores. Candidates seeking admission must meet the IIM Jammu eligibility criteria of the desired course and should have a valid score card of the entrance exam accepted for admission to the desired programme. However, candidates seeking admission to the Full-time PhD programme of IIM Jammu need not appear for any entrance exam if they have a postgraduate degree in management from any of the IIMs with a minimum 6.0 CGPA. The candidate can apply directly to the programme and appear for the personal interview round if shortlisted.
Admission Process 2025 for IIM Jammu is elaborated below:

1.Apply to the desired programme with relevant details and documents by visiting the official website of IIM Jammu, www.iimj.ac.in/. In the case of an MBA, candidates are only required to register at the official website of CAT, iimcat.ac.in.
2.Appear for the entrance exam required for the desired programme. The candidates need to meet the cut-off of that programme released by IIM Jammu.
3.After getting shortlisted on the basis of performance in the entrance exam, the candidates need to appear for a Personal Interview round.

4.A final Merit list for admission offers is prepared by IIM Jammu after all the selection rounds are over, taking into consideration various components such as academic profile, work experience, performance in the entrance exam, Gender and more.
5.The last step after receiving the admission offer is to pay the acceptance fee within the stipulated time to confirm the admission.

placement_data.title: IIM Jammu Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: The highest package recorded during IIM Jammu MBA placement 2025 was INR 26.6 LPA . The average and median package recorded was 16.04 LPA and 15.8 LPA . More than 200 recruiters visited and 250 offers were made during IIM Jammu placement 2025 for MBA. A total of 24 PPOs were made in 2025.

The MBA batch of 2025 comprised 255 students . Out of the total students, 54% students were Fresher. In the batch, 51 students were from Engineering background whereas 24 and 11 students were from Commerce and Science backgrounds. The remaining 8 and 6 students were from Arts and Others academic background.

description: IIM Jammu cutoff 2024 is available on this page for MBA/PGDM courses. Candidates can refer to the exam-wise sections below to view the IIM Jammu CAT cutoff 2024 across different courses and categories. Further updates related to CAT 2025 are provided below:

IIM Jammu CAT cutoff 2024 is based on candidates' performance in the entrance exam, followed by other parameters, including academic background, quality of work experience etc. The institute releases two types of CAT cutoffs, namely the Qualifying CAT cutoff and the Final CAT cutoff. Securing a minimum qualifying cutoff means that the candidate is eligible to get an interview call for WAT/ PI. Also, the IIM Jammu final CAT cutoff is always higher than the qualifying cutoff for admission.

IIM Jammu admission to management courses is based on valid CAT scores. For IIM Jammu MBA admission, students need to meet both the overall CAT cutoff percentile and the sectional cutoffs. The Institute does not release CAT cutoffs in the public domain and is exclusively accessible only via account login to candidates who have appeared for the exam. However, candidates can refer to the table below to check out the IIM Jammu CAT cutoff year-wise percentile for admission to the management courses.

IIM Jammu accepts CAT 2024 entrance exam scores for admission to MBA/PGDM courses followed by Group Discussion (GD), Analytical Writing Test (AWT) & Personal Interview (PI). Candidates seeking admission can refer to the table below to view the important CAT 2025 dates for admission.

reviews.review_heading: IIM Jammu review - The best place for holistic development.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus, and we have a state-of-the-art library with e-library access as well. There's an infirmary on our campus where 24-hour nursing staff is available, and a doctor is available every weekday. We also have our own ambulance and wheelchair. The mess facilities are amazing as well because they are student-run, and our friends and our batch mates are a part of it. So, we are always heard, and it makes an impact.

reviews.review_heading: Reality of IIM - the institute of national Importance.
reviews.review_text: We have 2 campuses for IIM Jammu, the canal road where the IPM batch is residing right now, has really bad infrastructure and bad hostel rooms. Classrooms have damaged projectors. The Wi-Fi is working and the library is too small to even have 20 people. Apart from that the Jagti campus, where the MBA is residing has a state of the art campus and everything is good there as it is new.

reviews.review_heading: It's a massive and wonderful experience there.
reviews.review_text: My college infrastructure is very wonderful. The course has state-of-the-art infrastructure such as classrooms with Wi-Fi, state-of-the-art laboratories, a well-equipped library, and access to online databases. The rooms have all the necessary facilities. Food is designed to keep you healthy. The college has adequate medical facilities and facilities for sports.

reviews.review_heading: IIM IN PARADISE: Indian Institute of Management, Jammu.
reviews.review_text: The new Jagti campus is huge and highly oriented for students comfort and safety. Even though it is still in construction, basic facilities are well provided. Whereas, the CRC campus is cozy yet, a bit behind in infrastructure. Canal Road campus is totally IPM-oriented.

reviews.review_heading: A good college to experience real college life.
reviews.review_text: In IIM Jammu, we have good infrastructure facilities that are well sufficient on both the permanent campus and the current campus. We have a library, basketball court, volleyball court, badminton court, and many indoor sports facilities. The food is just like the average hostel, and hostels are fine.

reviews.review_heading:
Life at a baby IIM - IIM Jammu 
.
reviews.review_text: The main campus of IIM Jammu which is located in Jagti, Jammu is not fully constructed and only MBA students stay there however IPM students stay in Canal Road Campus, Jammu. In Jagti, for MBA individual rooms are available with ACs however in CRC there are 3 to 4 girls allocated for one room. Wi-fi is provided 24/7 with optimism speed. Classrooms can easily accommodate 90 students, have well functioning projectors, charging point, speakers etc. The library is also open 24/7 where students can b...

reviews.review_heading: I love this institute and it is perhaps the best thing for me.
reviews.review_text: Once students start offline classes they will be getting into the new campus. It has all the facilities including Wi-Fi, laboratories, library, etc. It provides double-sharing hostel rooms. I have not get a chance to taste hostel's food, but seniors have never complained about it. Apart from these, it has a canteen and all other facilities.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good place to pursue an MBA. Our college has a lot of clubs and committees.
reviews.review_text: Currently, our college is operating on a temporary campus. Our college will shift to a permanent campus in 2022 or 2021. There are good infrastructure and very engaging facilities. Our college has all the needed amenities. It is a easily reachable place in Jammu, and we can reach the campus in 15 minutes from railway station and airport.

reviews.review_heading: Institute is good and has a good hostel life.
reviews.review_text: Sports and game facilities are awesome. There are various  sports competitions held. Infrastructure and facilities of course/department is superb. Currently IIM Jammu has a temporary campus, so permanent campus would be built in 4-5 years. Hostel and mess facilities are good.

reviews.review_heading: I am dissatisfied because of the online mode of teaching.
reviews.review_text: Since due to COVID situation we are not able to reach campus, but we have a Transit Campus right now, wherein 3 students are sharing a single room. The access to all the resources is made available, and also a hard copy of study materials reached our home for the first trimester.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the institute till now.
reviews.review_text: Till now we haven't visited the campus. The support from the library and IT department are good. The gym was recently renovated, and we have a badminton court, cricket field and a basketball court. Accommodation is offered on double sharing basis.

reviews.review_heading: If you are not getting any new IIM and don't want to take a drop, then do join here.
reviews.review_text: The institute is currently running from a non-permanent campus in Jammu city. But we get every possible facility. The mess and hostel quality is also good. The hostel is on twin share. We get almost every necessary equipment to play on the campus.

reviews.review_heading: IIM Jammu is one of the best among young IIMs.
reviews.review_text: Currently, IIM Jammu is on the temporary campus, which is around 5 kilometres radius from airport, railway station and bus stand. Still, we have a quite good campus. Our college provides all the games to play, gym and double sharing rooms. The permanent campus is supposed to be ready by 2022, which is far better than older IIMs in term of technology, etc.

reviews.review_heading: IIM Jammu is the best institute of management in India.
reviews.review_text: Facilities available in our institute are very good. The library has around 37,000 business books, other knowledge books, E-books and all online access. Classrooms are well-designed in a professional manner. Air-conditioners and projectors are available in classrooms. The canteen is available in the centre of campus.

reviews.review_heading: This college has the potential to become one of the leading schools in our country in future.
reviews.review_text: All the required facilities are available in the hostel, including geysers, etc. The quality of the food served is also good. There are gyms, playgrounds and other facilities too. Medical facilities are also available, and various Intra Institute Events also take place.

review_content.Placements: Placements were not available in our college. It is a government college but the college tries for student placements. It is the best college for students.

review_content.Faculty: Faculty members in our college were good and gave proper guidance for exams. They were very supportive and very helpful to students. The exams were conducted with proper maintenance.

reviews_list.review_title: It is a good college but needs more facilities and more practical sessions.

individual_reviews.title: Review of Kakinada Institute of Technology and Science, Tirupati.

content.Placements: Very good college placements are there for everyone. The college is very big and staff members provide a friendly atmosphere. individual_reviews.title: Our college is not good for placements, teachers, and atmosphere.

content.Placements: Placements and salary packages are not offered in our college. Recruiting companies do not visit our campus. Some students show their interest in internships individually.
content.Infrastructure: In our college, Wi-Fi and labs are not good for doing experiments. The mess and canteen are only for the girls' hostel. Sports and games are not available. There is no playground. It's not fair to expect more comfortable equipment.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech.) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: It is the best college for entering the industry.

content.Placements: Around 100% of our batchmates are currently placed, with some even having 2 or 3 offers. The highest salary package is 13 LPA and the lowest is 3.36 LPA. The top recruiting companies were Wipro and TCS. All students have internships with the companies they are currently placed with.
content.Infrastructure: All facilities are available, including water, electricity, and Wi-Fi, with up-to-date lab equipment. We also have a good library with all the books from our courses and some extra books. The mess is the best part, with the food tasting as if it were cooked at home. All sports are available and are free to play. Other facilities include a gym.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2017
individual_reviews.title: It is a great college but a little expensive.

content.Placements: This is one of the best colleges. All the teachers are familiar to students. I don't know much about the packages offered. Seniors are very good and friendly. All my classmates are helpful.
content.Infrastructure: All the facilities are available. Wi-Fi facility is available for students with a limit of 1 Gb per day. It is a great facility. Classrooms are well-designed. All types of sports facilities are available. All the required labs are present, and they were accessible around 1 PM onwards, but we used to learn many things there.
content.Faculty: All the teachers are highly qualified and helpful. All types of activities which help the students in their mental and physical development are conducted. The most interesting subject was English because our teacher used to create a corporate environment in the class that would increase our confidence levels.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech.) - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: The college is worth of money and has a good atmosphere.

content.Placements: The placement is not very good, but compared with other colleges of Uttarakhand, we can say that it is good. For computer branch, there are many companies, but for electronics, there is no chance. The only name of Birla is there, and you have to go off-campus. If you have that name, then you can select anywhere.
content.Infrastructure: The classrooms are not that much good, but the crowd is not that much, and professors are good. The toilets are well-maintained and cleaned. around 5 to 6 students can easily go at a time. The labs are also very good. All the useful instruments are used in the engineering.
